"""Fixture: refusal reason setter-byte assertion (legacy-kept)."""

from pathlib import Path

from tests.record_builder import RecordBuilder


def test_setter_byte_assertion(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    record_path = tmp_path / "demo.spec.md"
    record_path.write_text(
        RecordBuilder().spec(
            title="Setter Byte",
            id6="sb1001",
            status="approved",
            text_only=True,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    file_text = record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "- Status: approved" in file_text
